name: SMHI sea level observations (Sweden coast)
short: SMHI sea level at 71 Swedish coastal stations, in cm, minute values; free, keyless JSON.
summary: SMHI, the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute, serves oceanographic observations through an open JSON API. Parameter 13 is sea level as minute values in centimetres, with a station list and per-station series for the latest hour, day or months. The API answered without a key on 2026-11-08 and listed 71 stations.

tasks: current sea level at a Swedish coastal station
sea level in the last hour at a station
list of SMHI sea level stations

pricing.notes: Terms page: open data is free under CC BY 4.0 SE. No key mentioned; none was needed.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: Kungsvik latest-hour series ended within two minutes of the request time.

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: Kungsvik latest-hour series ended within two minutes of the request time.

coverage.notes: 71 stations listed for parameter 13 on 2026-11-08; the reference level of the values is not described in the API response.

licensing.summary: Terms page (Villkor for anvandning, updated 15 June 2026, read in Swedish): the open data follow Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 SE; copying, distributing and adapting are allowed, commercially too, naming SMHI as source and stating changes. Separate terms apply to consequence-based weather warnings, which are not part of this feed. AI training is not addressed.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Parameter 13 (sea level, minute values) with the station list.
Series of {date, value, quality} for one station; periods latest-hour, latest-day, latest-months.

api.rate_limits: None stated on the pages read.
api.notes: Values are in cm; each point has a quality flag.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each point carries a Unix millisecond date; how station clocks are kept is not stated.

location.unknown: Coordinates are published by the provider; nothing proves a device or station has not moved.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.
